title: Step 4 - Implementing R-Squared Score in Python with Scikit-Learn's Metrics

cues.en: Instructor: So let's go to a new tab.
cues.zh: 開啟新分頁。

cues.en: All right, and then let's just type because I'm gonna show you a trick actually.
cues.zh: 我會示範一個小技巧，先輸入。

cues.en: Let's just type scikit learn, scikit learn, just scikit learn.
cues.zh: 搜尋 scikit-learn，只要這個名稱。

cues.en: And then let's go to the first link, and you will be on the welcoming page of scikit-learn, which by the way looks super nice.
cues.zh: 點第一個連結，就會來到 scikit-learn 首頁，順帶一提，設計很好看。

cues.en: And then I'm gonna show you something very interesting.
cues.zh: 現在示範有趣的東西。

cues.en: I'm gonna show you the whole API of the scikit-learn library.
cues.zh: 看看整個 scikit-learn API。

cues.en: You know the API is the whole library containing all the modules and inside all the functions in the classes.
cues.zh: API 會列出整個函式庫的所有模組，以及其中的函數與類別。

cues.en: All right, so these are all the modules starting from the base one.
cues.zh: 這裡是所有模組，從 base 開始。

cues.en: And the one I actually want to show you right now is the metrics module.
cues.zh: 現在想介紹的是 metrics 模組。

cues.en: The metrics module, which we'll find by scrolling down a bit, scrolling down a bit more until we find M, should find it very quickly.
cues.zh: 往下捲到 M，很快就會找到。

cues.en: There we go, scikit learn metrics.
cues.zh: 就是 sklearn.metrics。

cues.en: All right, so as you might guess, this is the module that contains all the metrics of machine learning models, which therefore include classification models
cues.zh: 你可能猜到了，這個模組包含各種機器學習評估指標，包括第三部分要看的分類模型，

cues.en: which we'll see in part three, and what we are interested in now, the regression models.
cues.zh: 還有現在關心的迴歸模型。

cues.en: And in the regression models, here are the metrics.
cues.zh: 這裡是迴歸指標。

cues.en: Let's have a look.
cues.zh: 看一下。

cues.en: While you have many of them, you have the explained variant score, the max error, the mean absolute error, the mean squared error, the mean squared log error.
cues.zh: 有很多，例如 explained_variance_score、max_error、mean_absolute_error、mean_squared_error、mean_squared_log_error。

cues.en: You know, you have many of them, but the one we will use now after Kero's intuition lecture is, of course, the R squared.
cues.zh: 選項很多，但看過 Kirill 的直覺教學後，我們要使用的當然是 R²。

cues.en: The R squared score, which is of course, the coefficient of determination, regression score function.
cues.zh: r2_score，也就是決定係數的迴歸評分函數。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So there is not the adjusted R squared, but that's totally fine, the R squared is fine.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有調整後 R²，但沒關係，R² 已足夠。

cues.en: You will perfectly be able to evaluate the performance and mostly compare the performances of your regression models to select the best one.
cues.zh: 可以評估模型，尤其是比較各種迴歸模型的表現，選出最佳模型。

cues.en: So let's click this metric here, and we will find, well, the name of the function, which we will use, there you go, to measure the error squared coefficient
cues.zh: 點這個指標，就能找到用來衡量 R² 的函數名稱，

cues.en: for each of our different regression models here.
cues.zh: 用於各個迴歸模型。

cues.en: And that's exactly what you have at the end, this last cell, which I didn't want reveal until now, that's indeed the r2_score function, which allows to evaluate the model performance
cues.zh: 這就是每份實作最後、我剛才還沒揭曉的儲存格：r2_score，用它

cues.en: of your regression model with the R squared coefficient of determination.
cues.zh: 透過決定係數 R² 評估迴歸模型。

cues.en: All right, so you have the same in each regression models, you know, r2_score, right?
cues.zh: 每個模型都有相同的 r2_score。

cues.en: R2_score here as well.
cues.zh: 這裡也是。

cues.en: That's exactly the same code actually, because you know, I made these code templates 100% generic.
cues.zh: 程式碼完全相同，因為模板百分之百通用。

cues.en: So there you go, You have the r2_score function measuring the coefficient of determination, meaning the R squared.
cues.zh: r2_score 就是衡量決定係數，也就是 R² 的函數。

cues.en: And you know, still in the assumption that I had no idea on how to implement the R squared score.
cues.zh: 仍然假設我原本不知道如何實作 R²，

cues.en: Well here, what did I do?
cues.zh: 那我做了什麼？

cues.en: I actually went to the examples.
cues.zh: 查看使用範例。

cues.en: And there you go, I just took this line of code, which clearly means that we are measuring the R squared score between, you know, the vector of real results
cues.zh: 我直接取用這行程式，清楚表示衡量真實結果向量，

cues.en: and your vector of predictions.
cues.zh: 和預測向量之間的 R²。

cues.en: So I just took this, and then of course, I took this before in order to import, of course, the r2_score function from the metrics module from scikit-learn.
cues.zh: 也先複製這行，從 sklearn.metrics 匯入 r2_score。

cues.en: And so that's why, you know, in each implementation that's exactly what you see here.
cues.zh: 所以每份實作中，你看到的都是這樣。

cues.en: I import first the r2_score function from the metrics module by scikit-learn, and then I call this r2_score function on the y_test, which contains the real results,
cues.zh: 先從 sklearn.metrics 匯入 r2_score，再以 y_test，也就是測試集的真實結果，

cues.en: you know, the real values of the dependent variable in the test set and y_pred contain the predictions of the same observations in the test set.
cues.zh: 以及 y_pred，也就是相同測試觀測值的預測，呼叫函數。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So that's only what you would have to do in order to figure out how to, you know, evaluate the model performance of regression models, right?
cues.zh: 要找出如何評估迴歸模型效能，只需這樣做。

cues.en: So that's why I really want you to have the reflects to look at the documentation and quickly find the information you need.
cues.zh: 因此希望你養成查文件的習慣，快速找到需要的資訊。

cues.en: All right, and now my friends time for the exciting step.
cues.zh: 現在進入令人期待的步驟。

cues.en: I'm talking of course about the demo.
cues.zh: 當然就是示範。

cues.en: So let's just take a quick little break, and we'll start directly in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 稍作休息，下個教學直接開始。
